verdict: Ads are running and local presence is active, but lead tracking is broken.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, $1,698.97 went into Google Ads and produced 144 clicks and 16 recorded conversions — but the lead count showing as zero is a tracking problem, not a demand problem: conversion tracking has been broken for at least 45 days and is being repaired now. Google Business Profile delivered 119 local actions this period (42 calls, 41 direction requests, 36 website clicks), though engagement dropped sharply in the last week, with the final two days of the window showing no activity — a stall we're watching closely. Ad spend has also been uneven day-to-day, with roughly half the period running at or near zero, and campaign pacing is being reviewed to stabilize daily delivery. Several items land by August 31 — the Homer Glen branch page, a financing page, and the review campaign — that will support the push into heating season starting in October.

highlights.phrase: spent on Google Ads in the last 28 days, with campaigns actively running
local actions from your Google Business Profile this period — calls, directions, and site visits
drop in Google Business Profile engagement this past week, under active watch

watch_item.issue: Conversion tracking has not recorded a lead in 45 days, making it impossible to measure what the ad spend is actually producing.
watch_item.fix: Tracking is being repaired this cycle; once restored, accurate lead counts and cost-per-lead will appear in next week's report.
